correctness.rationale: Every S3 permutation is affine z->eps z+a over F3; for each of four sign assignments the product coefficients are fixed by N0 mod6 and three signed prefix sums T,U,V. Equality under all 36 two-letter substitutions is equivalent to equality of these four residues, because translation parameters vary independently. The derived append-zero/append-one maps are bijections on the full 6*3^3=162 signature space. Independently enumerated all binary words of length 0..13 and direct evaluations for all 36 S3 substitution pairs; recovered exactly (1,2,4,8,15,26,41,60,84,108,133,148,159,162). Independently replayed all 162 length-13 CERTIFICATE.tsv witnesses and verified no incorrect or duplicate signatures. Full reachability at 13 and bijective transition prove all n>=13, while 159 at 12 proves sharpness; not an infinite inference from samples.
